battery.part: Shorai LFX14A4-BS12 (LiFePO4, 4.5 Ah true, 59.4 Wh, 210 CCA, 0.90 kg)
battery.note: a 15 mA keyless+telematics standby drains the 4.5 Ah battery in ~12 days: design rule = VCU wakes once a day, closes contactors and tops the 12 V battery from the pack via the DC-DC for ~10 min (as cars do); without top-up the standby budget is 3.75 mA

CAN1_powertrain_500k: isolation monitor iso175 (term. at far end)
can.diagnostic: OBD-style service connector on CAN2 under the seat; BMS also on CAN2 for Orion utility
can.topology: two linear buses, 120 ohm split termination at both physical ends, stubs < 0.3 m, twisted pair 0.35 mm2 FLRY-B, total length CAN1 ~2.5 m, CAN2 ~3.5 m

keyless.concept: proximity fob (125 kHz LF wake + 315/433 MHz UHF) -> keyless ECU on CAN2 -> VCU authorises READY; electric steering lock; immobiliser challenge between keyless ECU and VCU and inverter (CAN2/1 gateway in VCU)
keyless.start: fob present + side-stand up + brake held + start button -> VCU: BMS OK, iso OK, HVIL closed -> precharge -> main+ -> READY lamp
keyless.reference: production motorcycles use this pattern (e.g. BMW Keyless Ride); hardware: Continental/Huf-class keyless module, choose with VCU supplier
